title: Social Studio
views.label: Views
notAllowed: Not allowed to read social posts.
none: No social account is connected yet. Connect one on endue.ai, then turn on the endue account's connectors in Settings, Connections.
empty.numbers: No numbers yet: a network that does not give them shows none.
truncated: Cut short here; the network has the whole text.
grant.read: To show the posts, replies and numbers of your social accounts.
grant.accounts: To show which social accounts are connected and whether they sync.
compose.empty: Write a post once, see how each account takes it, and publish it to them.
compose.title: Title, for the networks that take one
compose.text: What do you want to say?
compose.noAccounts: No social account is connected yet.
alt: Describe it for people who cannot see it
notPicture: {name} is not a picture or a video.
fit.empty: Write something or add a picture.
fit.titleTooLong: The title is longer than {network} takes ({max} characters).
fit.mediaRequired: {network} needs a picture or a video.
fit.no.image: {network} does not take pictures from here.
fit.no.video: {network} does not take videos from here.
fit.type: {network} does not take a file like {name}.
fit.unknown: {network} checks this post when it is published.
outcome.unknown: No answer came back, so the post may be up on {network}: look there before trying again.
review.key: Your endue key may not publish yet: publishing first asks the endue account to let it.
review.final: A published post cannot be taken back from here.
talk.deleted: Deleted on {network}. It leaves the list when the account syncs.
talk.confirm: Delete “{post}” on {network}? This cannot be undone.
keyRefused: The endue account did not let the key publish.
grant.drafts: To read your drafts in Documents, Social Studio.
grant.write: To keep your drafts in Documents, Social Studio.
grant.pictures: To copy the picture into its draft.
grant.account: To publish, reply and delete through your endue account.
grant.help: To ask the assistant to shorten or adapt the post.
